name: アテンションマップ整合性
description: 分析します spatial attention パターン を検出するために 不整合 typical of AI生成の images.
algorithm: Self-Attention Consistency Analysis for Synthetic Image Detection
mechanism: AI生成の images often exhibit unnatural attention パターン where different regions show inconsistent levels of detail. This method 分析する local コントラスト, detail density, and sharpness 分布 maps.
parameters: Attention map: 勾配-weighted, Scales: 3 (fine/medium/coarse), Consistency: cross-scale 相関
source: Zhao, T. et al. (2023) — Multi-Attentional Deepfake Detection, CVPR
useCase: Detecting AI生成の images by identifying unnatural spatial attention 分布s

references.title: Zhao, T. et al. (2023) — Multi-Attentional Deepfake Detection, CVPR

strengths:
• Captures high-level semantic アーティファクト
• Works にわたる generation methods
• Multi-scale 分析
• Interpretable attention maps
limitations:
• Requires sufficient image complexity
• May struggle with simple scenes
• Attention パターン vary by content
• Training-dependent performance
